name: Notion
tagline: Notes, docs and databases in one workspace
description: Notion combines notes, documents and databases in one workspace. Its pricing page positions it as 'one tool to run your company', with Free, Plus, Business and Enterprise plans.
features: Notion AI (limited trial on Free and Plus)
Notion Agent and AI Meeting Notes (Business)
Custom Agents priced per Notion credit
audience: Students and educators (free Plus for 1 member)
strengths: Free Plus plan for students and educators with a school email
limitations: Free multi-member workspaces have a block limit (number not stated)
Free plan limits: 5 MB uploads, 7-day page history, 10 guests

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Yearly billing is described as 'save up to 20%'; the yearly per-month price was not captured

plans.name: Business
highlights: Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search (beta)

plans.name: Enterprise
highlights: Zero data retention with LLM providers

free.details: Single-member workspaces have unlimited pages and blocks. Limits: 5 MB uploads, 7-day page history, 10 external guests, 1 notion.site domain.

api.summary: Custom Agents are free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits. Custom domains are $8 per month per domain billed annually or $10 monthly. Public API pricing is not stated.

pricing.regional: Prices are in USD. Customers in the EU, UK and other regions with mandatory refund rules may be eligible for refunds beyond the standard 72 hours.
